self_check.null_and_missing_attribution: pass — record_filter drops HDR/TRL and short lines; REC-TYPE outside {01,02} lands as record_type=UNKNOWN rather than being silently coerced
self_check.no_shared_ddl: pass — no DDL run; Airbyte created the target table
self_check.rerun_safety: pass — full_refresh_overwrite, verified by the second sync
self_check.secrets: pass — presigned URLs and client secrets are TF_VAR/GitHub secrets only; feed_urls is airbyte_secret in the spec
self_check.parity_vs_tolerance: exact parity (contract: fixed-width parse must match the legacy job record for record)
self_check.capability_preflight: pass — local declarative-CDK read of the manifest matched the legacy parser for all 100 records before the Builder run

unverified_paths: cron-scheduled sync (only API-triggered jobs were observed)
presigned URL expiry (7 days): the source needs fresh URLs via TF_VAR_custbill_feed_urls after that; a stable HTTP endpoint was not provisioned
invoice id: the CBCUST01 layout carries no invoice identifier, so none is emitted; record_key is file:md5(record) and is stable only while the record text is unchanged
schema-change propagation (propagate_columns) on a changed copybook
